items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Oscar and I, you know, we kind of thought alike. So we kind of gravitated toward eachother. Whe he'd come to town he would kind of seek me out, or if I was around him I would seek him out. And we would play

ctx.x: That's right, that's right. So this was -- here we go again -- this is why I never got a chance to do anything. But the money was good and so I just stayed there and made the money and, you know, sent my kids through school, you know, one of those things. But any way I did some -- I did have a couple of solos with Nat. Let's see, I did quite a few solos with him, but I had to -- now here's the funny thing. I would have to do -- to copy the solos that were played by Oscar, and Irving because we would record all…
